required_limitations.no_extrapolation: The slope describes the linear association within the observed range of the predictor and should not be extrapolated beyond it.
required_limitations.nonrandom_design: Random allocation was not established. This analysis describes an association and does not establish causation.
required_limitations.analysis_assumptions: Inference is conditional on the stated independent observations and the method's distribution and model assumptions; descriptive checks do not prove these assumptions.
required_limitations.influential_observations: Potential influential observations were flagged. The fitted slope may be sensitive to particular records; flagged records were not automatically removed.
